# f1db-mini - replay fixture

A subset of the f1db release v2026.15.1 (seasons 1950, 1951, 1955, 1963, 1988, 2008, 2024-2026)
cut by `../make_f1db_mini.py`, used by the Lane 1 replay e2e test.

Data: F1DB (CC BY 4.0) - https://github.com/f1db/f1db. Redistributed unmodified apart from
row/column subsetting, under the same licence.
